papers.title: Measurement of the electron-hole pair creation energy in a 4H-SiC p-n diode
papers.summary: For 4H silicon carbide (4H-SiC), the values for the electron-hole pair creation energy $ε_{\text{i}}$ published in the literature vary significantly. This work presents an experimental determination of $ε_{\text{i}}$ using $50$ $μ$m 4H-SiC p-n diodes designed for particle detection in high-energy physics.
